headline: Looks like a chatbot. Answers like you.
supportingLine: Your answers. Ready when customers ask.
explanation: AI helps with the first draft. You decide what customers read.
taxPresentation: Verify GST status before publication; do not infer it from an inclusive Stripe price.

plans.name: SayGday
plans.label: You manage the answers
includes: Draft questions and answers from the business website
Owner review, editing and approval dashboard
Chat appearance personalisation using existing settings
Visitor-submitted enquiries with an email address for follow-up
excludes: Ongoing writing or editing as a managed service
plans.usageAllowanceNote: Do not invent a message cap or advertise unlimited usage; verify actual limits and policy before making a public claim.

plans.name: SayGday Managed
plans.label: A hand getting started and keeping it useful
plans.installation: Standard installation on one supported website, subject to access and compatibility
plans.monthlyContentWorkIncludes: One monthly review and small answer updates within the total time allowance
plans.extraWork: Quote and agree additional writing, sites, integrations or involved website work before starting

accountMessageRules.price: Use the verified account-specific amount, not a hardcoded new-customer price
accountMessageRules.dates: Use the verified account-specific trial and billing dates in the customer's relevant timezone
accountMessageRules.enquirySuccess: Display only after confirmed server success; do not imply delivery when only storage or queueing is confirmed

publicationGates: Agree operational capacity and scope for Managed
Verify total price and tax presentation
Coordinate new price objects, server validation, checkout and marketing
Preserve valid existing subscriptions, agreed prices and trial dates
Update SayGday's own website-chat answers with the same live offer
Test supported installation, trial activation, cancellation and renewal
Keep Managed enquiry-led until its service and billing workflow are ready
